atlas: Leonida Trophy Atlas data, guides written for this entry

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum opens only when the other 54 trophies are all earned, so treat it as the finish line of the whole atlas rather than a task of its own. Work the roadmap stages in order, keep the checklist synced after every session, and use the progress counter to see exactly which grade group still owes you trophies. When the counter reads 54 of 54 besides this one, the platinum pops on its own.
steps: Clear every story and chapter trophy first so the map and activities are fully open.
Sweep the counted grinds next: stunts, shooting range golds, card sets and location lists.
Finish the money and property trophies with late game income.
Check the atlas counter; at 54 earned the platinum awards itself.
sources: Exophase, Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles, Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
Official PlayStation trophy data in the bounty kit starter

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Gone Fishing is the opening mission, so this trophy is the reward for starting the story and playing the prologue through to its end. Follow the on screen prompts, learn the movement and driving basics as the game teaches them, and do not skip the closing cutscene. The trophy lands as the mission complete banner appears.
steps: Start a new game and play the opening sequence.
Follow every tutorial prompt until the final objective.
Finish the last objective and let the mission complete screen play out.
sources: Exophase, Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles, Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Chapter 1 closes once its chain of story missions is done, ending with the chapter's final set piece. Keep following the main story markers on the map, since side content never blocks chapter progress. If a mission offers a choice, pick either branch; chapter completion counts the same. The trophy pops at the chapter end card.
steps: Play every main story mission marked in Chapter 1 in order.
Keep both protagonists' introductory arcs moving when the game switches between them.
Complete the chapter finale mission and watch the chapter end sequence.
sources: Exophase, Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles, Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Chapter 2 widens the map and the trophy is awarded for finishing its full mission chain. The name is printed with asterisks by PlayStation itself, so do not be surprised by the spelling in your list. Push the story markers through the chapter's trade arc and the trophy unlocks when the chapter closes.
steps: Work through the Chapter 2 story missions as they appear on the map.
Complete the mid chapter setup and its payoff mission.
Finish the chapter finale to trigger the unlock.
sources: Exophase, Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles, Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Chapter 3 is the Vice City chapter and its trophy is a straight story completion award. By now both protagonists are playable, so alternate their mission strands whenever one strand stalls waiting for the other. Finish the chapter's closing mission and the trophy is yours.
steps: Alternate between both protagonists' Chapter 3 missions so neither strand blocks the other.
Complete the Vice City set piece missions in the middle of the chapter.
Play the chapter finale through to the end card.
sources: Exophase, Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles, Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Chapter 4 is the penultimate chapter and the trophy follows its final mission. Difficulty spikes here, so stock ammunition and armour before the last two missions and use Combat Focus generously. Completion, not performance, is all the trophy asks for.
steps: Clear the Chapter 4 mission chain in order.
Restock armour, snacks and ammunition before the final two missions.
Complete the chapter finale to earn the trophy.
sources: Exophase, Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles, Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: This gold trophy is the story's true ending: finish the final mission after Chapter 4. Save in a separate slot before starting it, because the endgame can lock free roam options until the credits finish. Any ending branch counts; the trophy awards on the mission complete screen after the finale.
steps: Finish Chapter 4 so the final mission unlocks.
Save into a spare slot, then start the final mission fully stocked.
Play the finale to its end; the gold pops with mission complete.
sources: Exophase, Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles, Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Breakfast Run is a named story mission and the trophy is earned by completing it whenever it appears in the chain. It plays as an early errand style mission, so expect driving and a short delivery objective rather than a shootout. Finish every objective and the trophy follows the mission complete banner.
steps: Accept the Breakfast Run mission when its marker appears.
Drive the route and complete the delivery objective.
Finish the closing objective so the mission registers as complete.
sources: Exophase, Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles, Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: The Cartel Heist is a headline story heist and the trophy simply records finishing it. Heists run in setup and finale stages, so complete every setup task the board lists before the finale unlocks. Bring your strongest weapons for the escape; the trophy pops when the heist pays out.
steps: Complete each Cartel Heist setup mission on the planning board.
Start the finale with full armour and your best loadout.
Escape the wanted level at the end so the heist completes and pays out.
sources: Exophase, Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles, Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Child's Play is a character driven story mission and finishing it earns the trophy. The mission leans on dialogue and a short escort sequence rather than open combat. Stay close to the character you are escorting and the mission, and trophy, complete cleanly.
steps: Start Child's Play from its story marker.
Stay with the escorted character and clear each checkpoint in order.
Complete the final scene to register the mission as done.
sources: Exophase, Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles, Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Headliners is a story mission built around a public event going wrong, and completing it earns the trophy. Expect crowd areas where heavy weapons draw instant attention, so follow the mission's own stealth or chase beats as scripted. The unlock arrives with the mission complete screen.
steps: Begin Headliners at its marker and follow the event setup.
Play the scripted disruption and chase in objective order.
Reach the final objective and finish the mission.
sources: Exophase, Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles, Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: VCIA Takedown is the airport story mission, set around Vice City International Airport, and the trophy marks its completion. Airport missions usually mix a vehicle section with an on foot finale, so keep a fast car ready for the approach. Finish the last objective on the airfield side and the trophy unlocks.
steps: Start VCIA Takedown and complete the approach drive to the airport.
Work through the airfield objectives as they update.
Complete the escape objective to finish the mission.
sources: Exophase, Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles, Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Operation Savage Glory is a large scale story operation and the trophy is its completion award. Treat it like a mini heist: long firefights, vehicle switches and a timed escape are the pattern for missions named as operations. Stock up first, then play it end to end.
steps: Start Operation Savage Glory fully stocked with armour and ammunition.
Clear the operation's combat stages in objective order.
Finish the escape stage so the operation registers complete.
sources: Exophase, Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles, Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: The second gold asks for a full 100 percent completion stat, which in this series means the story, every stranger strand, the counted activities, the collectible sets and full map exploration rather than literally every side task in the game. Track your percentage in the pause menu and let this atlas mirror it: when every other category here is ticked, the percentage should be at the top. Save this for last among the golds.
steps: Finish the story, all stranger strands and every counted activity list.
Complete the collectible sets and explore all 52 areas of Leonida.
Check the in game completion percentage and mop up whichever category still shows a gap.
sources: Exophase, Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles, Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
Official PlayStation trophy data in the bounty kit starter

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Two hundred and fifty completed stunts is a grind of small jumps rather than one hard feat: stunt jumps scattered over Leonida each count once when you land them cleanly. Work region by region with a fast bike or a light sports car, and mark regions off in this atlas as you clear them so you never re-drive a finished area. Failed landings do not count, so approach each ramp at the speed its run up naturally gives you.
steps: Pick one region and clear every stunt jump in it before moving on.
Use a motorcycle or light car and land cleanly past the marked landing zone.
Repeat region by region until the counter reaches 250.
sources: Exophase, Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles, Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: The game tracks nine activity types and this trophy asks only that you sample each one a single time. It is the natural first side trophy: as new activity icons appear on your map, detour once, play the opening round or event, and move on. Races, the shooting range, fishing, drone events and the arcade are among the families to sample.
steps: Open the map and note each distinct activity icon family.
Play one short session of each of the nine types.
After the ninth different type registers, the trophy unlocks.
sources: Exophase, Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles, Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: All 42 Shooting Range challenges must end with a gold medal, which makes this a practice trophy: each weapon class has its own challenge set and its own accuracy rhythm. Learn one range board at a time, memorise where targets appear, and replay immediately while the pattern is fresh. Golds are kept permanently once earned, so chip away at the list over several sessions.
steps: Start with the pistol challenges and learn the target patterns for that board.
Replay each challenge until its medal turns gold, then move to the next weapon class.
Finish all 42 challenges at gold to earn the silver.
sources: Exophase, Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles, Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Top Fun drone races run at 14 locations and you must win one race at each. Drone handling is twitchy at full throttle, so feather the turns and learn each course with one exploratory run before racing for the win. A win at a location is permanent; work the locations in map order and tick them off here as you go.
steps: Visit each Top Fun location and fly one practice run to learn its gates.
Race again at full pace, cutting inside lines on the wide gates.
Win at all 14 locations to complete the trophy.
sources: Exophase, Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles, Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Twenty different races must be won, and repeats of the same race do not add to the count, so variety matters more than mastery. Start with short street races in a tuned car, then move through the bike, off road and water events as they unlock. Keep a simple tally in this atlas each time a brand new race is won.
steps: Enter races you have never won before, starting with the shortest street events.
Bring a vehicle suited to each class; a tuned car covers most early races.
Reach 20 unique race wins to unlock the trophy.
sources: Exophase, Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles, Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Cal is the fishing rival and this trophy is a single challenge win against him. Fishing challenges score on the catch, so learn the cast and reel timing on ordinary fish first, then take Cal's challenge at a spot you already know. If you lose, the challenge can be retried; only the win counts.
steps: Practise fishing until you can land fish without snapping the line.
Accept Cal's fishing challenge at his spot.
Out-catch him within the challenge rules to earn the trophy.
sources: Exophase, Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles, Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Somewhere in Leonida an arcade cabinet holds a full playable game, and finishing that game, not just starting it, earns the trophy. Pick the shortest cabinet game you find, learn its stages, and play it to its actual end screen. It is a relaxing break trophy between story missions.
steps: Find an arcade cabinet with a full game and start it.
Play through the game's stages to its end screen.
Exit the cabinet after completion registers.
sources: Exophase, Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles, Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Andy is one of the stranger style contacts whose missions form a strand, and the trophy lands on his final mission. Strands unlock in sequence, so if Andy's marker vanishes, progress his earlier jobs or the story until he calls again. Finish his last job and the strand, and trophy, close together.
steps: Complete Andy's missions in the order his strand offers them.
Return whenever his marker reappears after story progress.
Finish Andy's final mission to earn the trophy.
sources: Exophase, Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles, Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Kenton's strand ends with a mission the title jokes is no boat accident, and completing that finale earns the trophy. Work Kenton's jobs as they appear, expect a water or coastal setting for the last one, and bring a boat friendly loadout. The trophy pops at the strand's end.
steps: Play Kenton's strand missions in sequence.
Keep returning to his marker as new jobs unlock.
Complete Kenton's final mission for the trophy.
sources: Exophase, Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles, Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Billy's strand is a solo rider's storyline and the trophy is awarded for its final mission. Billy's jobs tend to involve long rides, so keep a reliable motorcycle stored nearby. Finish his last mission and the strand closes with the trophy.
steps: Complete Billy's missions as his strand unfolds.
Use a dependable bike for his ride heavy jobs.
Finish Billy's final mission to unlock the trophy.
sources: Exophase, Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles, Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Eight full stranger strands must be completed anywhere in Leonida for this silver. Each strand is a short chain for one character, and the named contacts in this atlas, Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy and Tyrone among them, each contribute one. Do strands as they appear rather than hoarding them; the eighth completed strand triggers the trophy.
steps: Accept every stranger strand you meet on the map.
Finish each strand fully, including its final mission.
Complete your eighth strand to earn the silver.
sources: Exophase, Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles, Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Randy runs a supply style strand of deliveries and collections, and the trophy marks its final mission. Expect timed driving legs, so keep a fast, sturdy vehicle as your default while working his jobs. Complete the last delivery and Randy's strand, and the trophy, are done.
steps: Work Randy's delivery strand in order.
Use a fast durable vehicle for the timed legs.
Complete Randy's final mission to earn the trophy.
sources: Exophase, Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles, Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Tyrone's strand closes with a final mission that earns this trophy. His jobs build in difficulty, so upgrade your main vehicle and weapons as the strand progresses. When his last marker appears, finish that mission and the strand completes.
steps: Complete Tyrone's strand missions in sequence.
Upgrade your vehicle and loadout as his jobs get harder.
Finish Tyrone's final mission for the trophy.
sources: Exophase, Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles, Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.missableReason: This is the atlas's one missable flag. The meditation spots are tied to quiet viewpoints that the story's later chapters change: once the endgame reshapes parts of the coast and two spots sit inside areas the finale closes off, an unvisited spot can no longer be reached on that save. Meditate at all 18 spots before starting the final mission, or keep a pre-finale save, and the trophy stays safe.
trophies.guide: Eighteen meditation spots are spread across Leonida and each one asks you to stop and meditate at a marked viewpoint. This is the one trophy in the list flagged missable in this atlas: later story events close off the areas holding two of the spots, so clear the full set before the final mission or keep a save from before it. Visit spots region by region alongside your exploration trophy progress so no viewpoint is left behind.
steps: Sweep each region for its meditation spots while exploring that region.
Interact at every spot and let the meditation finish fully.
Complete all 18 spots before starting the final story mission.
sources: Exophase, Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles, Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
Official PlayStation trophy data in the bounty kit starter

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Bret the hunter wants one specific unique animal, a named legendary style hunt rather than ordinary wildlife. Take his job, follow the tracking clues in the marked territory, and use a scoped weapon for a clean kill at range. Deliver the hunt's conclusion to Bret and the trophy follows.
steps: Accept Bret's hunting job and travel to the marked territory.
Follow the tracks and clues until the unique animal appears.
Kill it cleanly and complete Bret's hand in to earn the trophy.
sources: Exophase, Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles, Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Collectible cards are grouped into themed sets and finishing any three full sets earns this silver. Cards sit in shops, interiors and landmarks, so grab every card you pass from the very start; a set only counts when its last card is collected. Focus your sweep on one set at a time and use the atlas to note which sets are closest to done.
steps: Pick up every collectible card you encounter from the opening hours onward.
Choose the set nearest completion and sweep its remaining locations.
Finish three complete sets to earn the silver.
sources: Exophase, Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles, Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: WAiNK spots are marked locations where you perform the game's signature WAiNK interaction, and there are at least 100 of them to use. They behave like a photo or check in collectible: arrive, trigger the prompt, move on. Clear them region by region with the exploration sweep and the count climbs steadily to 100.
steps: Note WAiNK markers as you explore each region.
Stop and trigger the WAiNK prompt at every marked location.
Reach 100 locations to earn the silver.
sources: Exophase, Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles, Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: The game offers rotating and standing challenges, and any 50 completions count toward this trophy. Mix short challenges into ordinary play: a race here, a range board there, a stunt set between missions. Because only the total matters, favour the quick challenges and the counter fills itself.
steps: Open the challenges list and pin the shortest ones first.
Complete challenges in batches between story missions.
Reach 50 completed challenges for the trophy.
sources: Exophase, Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles, Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: You need a four star wanted level while your partner is with you, and then a clean escape with that partner still present. Raise the heat in an open area with a fast escape route, call or collect your partner first, and once the fourth star lands, break line of sight and hide until the stars drain. Swapping to a fresh vehicle out of sight speeds the escape.
steps: Ride together with your partner in the same vehicle.
Commit crimes until the wanted level reaches four stars.
Break police line of sight and stay hidden until the wanted level clears.
sources: Exophase, Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles, Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Three shop robberies in a row, with your partner, and the wanted level must never fully clear between them, which makes this a routing trophy. Pick a tight cluster of three shops on one street, keep your partner in the car, and drive straight from till to till while the heat stays warm. If the stars drain to zero, restart the chain.
steps: Choose three shops close together and bring your partner along.
Rob the first shop and drive directly to the second while still wanted.
Rob the third shop without the wanted level ever clearing to earn the trophy.
sources: Exophase, Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles, Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: A vehicle is discovered when you get in and drive it for the first time, and 100 distinct models is the target. Rich districts spawn the rare cars, so cruise new neighbourhoods and swap into anything you do not recognise. Stealing parked cars in varied areas fills the count far faster than waiting for traffic alone.
steps: Enter and drive every unfamiliar vehicle model you see.
Hunt rare models in wealthy districts, marinas and the airport.
Reach 100 discovered vehicles for the trophy.
sources: Exophase, Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles, Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Combat Focus slows the fight and this trophy wants five takedowns inside one activation. Set it up deliberately: find a group of five or more enemies, weaken your aim onto them in a line, then trigger Focus and sweep headshots before the meter ends. Mission ambushes and gang hideouts give the densest groups.
steps: Locate a group of at least five enemies standing fairly close together.
Line up your shots, then activate Combat Focus.
Drop five enemies before the Focus meter runs out.
sources: Exophase, Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles, Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Unconfirmed method: the description points at Vice City International Airport and an unscheduled departure, which most plausibly means stealing an aircraft or vehicle and leaving the airfield without clearance rather than using a story flight. Head to VCIA in free roam, take a plane or fast vehicle from the airfield side, and get airborne or away cleanly. Because no public source confirms the exact trigger yet, try both a stolen plane takeoff and a runway vehicle escape if the first attempt does not pop it.
steps: Enter the VCIA airfield in free roam, outside any mission.
Steal an aircraft and take off without using a scheduled flight.
If that does not trigger it, retry with a fast vehicle departure from the runway area.
sources: Exophase, Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles, Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Unconfirmed method: Rhinos are the game's tanks, and the jokey description suggests spending time inside one, most likely stealing a Rhino and surviving in it, possibly while wanted. Tanks appear at high wanted levels and military sites; hijack one when it rolls out, then stay in the seat while the heat is on. No public source confirms whether a timer, a wanted level or a kill count is the real trigger, so experiment in one long Rhino session.
steps: Raise your wanted level or visit a military area until a Rhino tank appears.
Hijack the Rhino and stay inside it while under fire.
Keep driving and surviving in the tank until the trophy triggers.
sources: Exophase, Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles, Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: One jewelry store robbed in complete stealth is the whole ask. Scout the store first, enter quietly outside peak hours in game, avoid firing a shot, and take the goods without any guard or customer raising the alarm. If detection flashes, leave and reset rather than forcing the robbery; a clean silent run is what counts.
steps: Choose a jewelry store and watch its guard pattern from outside.
Enter quietly, loot the cases without shooting or being spotted.
Leave the area undetected to earn the trophy.
sources: Exophase, Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles, Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Five bank vault robberies, each ending in a successful escape, earn this silver. Vault jobs are the heavy end of free roam crime: bring armour, a getaway vehicle placed before you enter, and a route that breaks line of sight fast. A robbery only counts once you have escaped, so prioritise the getaway over grabbing every last bundle.
steps: Pick a bank, park a getaway car nearby, and rob its vault.
Escape the wanted level completely after each robbery.
Repeat at five vaults in total to earn the silver.
sources: Exophase, Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles, Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Armored trucks roam the map as random events; rob one and escape. Block the truck, deal with its guards, blow or open the rear doors, grab the cash and lose the wanted level. Keep a sticky explosive or heavy weapon ready, since the doors will not open for light fire.
steps: Find a roaming armored truck and block its route.
Open the rear doors with explosives and take the cash.
Escape the wanted level to complete the trophy.
sources: Exophase, Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles, Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Leonida is divided into 52 areas and each must be visited to clear the fog from the map. Drive or fly a grid pattern over any region your map still shows as unexplored, including the water edges and islands. Pair this sweep with the meditation spots and WAiNK locations so one long road trip serves three trophies at once.
steps: Open the map and identify every still fogged area.
Travel through each missing area until it registers as explored.
Cover all 52 areas to earn the trophy.
sources: Exophase, Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles, Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Nine gangs run illegal operations across the state and you must rob one operation belonging to each. Gang sites sit in distinct territories, so work territory by territory and note which gangs you have already hit in this atlas. Only the first robbery per gang advances the count.
steps: Locate an illegal operation inside one gang's territory.
Rob it and escape, then record that gang as done.
Repeat until all 9 gangs have been robbed once.
sources: Exophase, Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles, Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Unconfirmed specifics: the description names Ocean Beach and a cocktail with a view, which reads as an interaction at a beachfront bar or rooftop spot overlooking that beach. Visit Ocean Beach, look for a bar counter or lounge with an order prompt, and buy or accept a cocktail while facing the ocean view. The exact venue is not publicly confirmed, so try the beachfront bars along that strip until the prompt appears.
steps: Travel to Ocean Beach in free roam.
Find a beachfront bar or lounge with a drink interaction prompt.
Order the cocktail and stay for the view until the trophy pops.
sources: Exophase, Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles, Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Vehicle showrooms have glass fronts made to be driven through. Get inside a showroom, take one of its display cars, and drive straight out through the glass in one clean smash. Any showroom car counts; the style the title jokes about is simply the classic through the window exit.
steps: Enter a vehicle showroom on foot.
Get into a display car inside the showroom.
Accelerate straight out through the glass front.
sources: Exophase, Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles, Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: The Kolt and Associates bowling alley hosts this small activity trophy, earned by bowling there with a proper follow through, which the game reads from a full game or a scored throw at that alley. Head to the alley, start a game, and bowl your frames with the standard throw motion. It is one of the quickest trophies on the list.
steps: Travel to the Kolt & Associates bowling alley.
Start a bowling game at that alley.
Bowl with a full follow through throw to trigger the trophy.
sources: Exophase, Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles, Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: Unconfirmed method: the vague description points at the two protagonists' partnership reaching a public milestone, most plausibly a story beat or a joint activity performed together in view of a crowd. Keep playing the story with both characters cooperating and try partner activities in busy public places. No public source confirms the trigger yet, so treat story completion as the safe path and note that this guide marks the trophy honestly as unconfirmed.
steps: Progress the main story, where partnership beats are scripted.
Play partner activities together in public locations.
If it has not popped by the finale, revisit crowded partner spots in free roam.
sources: Exophase, Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles, Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Unconfirmed count: PlayStation tracks a hidden count for this trophy and community listing data associates it with making choices, with the tracker reportedly running to 500. Dialogue and mission choices across the whole game feed it, so answer prompts rather than letting them time out, and pick the active option in every branching conversation. Because the exact count is not officially published, this atlas marks the method unconfirmed; steady story play is the reliable route.
steps: Make an active choice at every dialogue and mission branch.
Avoid letting choice prompts expire unused.
Keep choosing through the story until the tracked count completes the trophy.
sources: Exophase, Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles, Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Unconfirmed method: the description implies failing at something and then succeeding on the second attempt, most plausibly a retry of a challenge, race or mission checkpoint. The cheapest deliberate setup is to enter a short race or challenge, fail it on purpose, then immediately retry and win it. No public source confirms which activity the game watches, so if the race route fails, apply the same fail then succeed pattern to a shooting range challenge.
steps: Enter a short race or challenge and fail it deliberately.
Immediately retry the same event.
Win the retry to satisfy the second time condition.
sources: Exophase, Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles, Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: Unconfirmed method: this is the list's strange event trophy, the series tradition of a UFO, ghost or other weird encounter hidden somewhere in the world, usually at night and often in remote areas. Explore the swamps, mountains and coast after dark and investigate any strange light or sound event you find. No public source confirms the location, so this guide marks it unconfirmed rather than inventing a spot.
steps: Explore remote areas of Leonida at night.
Investigate strange lights, sounds or events when they appear.
Witness the full strange event to earn the trophy.
sources: Exophase, Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles, Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: A melee drive by means striking a pedestrian with a melee weapon from a moving vehicle, bowling them over as the title says. Ride a motorcycle or drive slowly past a lone pedestrian, swing your melee weapon as you pass, and make contact without running them over with the vehicle itself. A quiet street and low speed make the timing easy.
steps: Equip a melee weapon and get on a motorcycle or into a car.
Ride slowly toward a lone pedestrian.
Swing the melee weapon as you pass so the hit, not the vehicle, knocks them down.
sources: Exophase, Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles, Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Marked Bills come from robberies and must be washed through your laundering contacts, with 250,000 dollars of laundered earnings as the target. Feed every marked bill you earn into the laundering route instead of spending it raw, and chain vault and operation robberies to keep the supply coming. The counter only tracks money that completes the laundering process.
steps: Earn Marked Bills from robberies and heist style jobs.
Deliver them to your laundering contacts whenever you hold a batch.
Repeat until 250,000 dollars has been laundered in total.
sources: Exophase, Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles, Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Lifetime shop spending of 100,000 dollars across every shop type is the target, and it accumulates naturally if you buy rather than steal your gear. Weapons, ammunition, clothing, vehicle work and properties services all feed the same counter. If you are short late in the game, a deliberate shopping round with your heist money closes the gap in minutes.
steps: Buy weapons, ammunition and clothing from shops instead of relying on pickups.
Pay for vehicle repairs and custom work at shops.
Keep spending across all shop types until the lifetime total passes 100,000 dollars.
sources: Exophase, Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles, Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Eight garage properties are for sale across Leonida and owning all eight earns the trophy. Garages appear as property icons once you can afford property; buy them as your income grows, starting with the cheapest, and save the expensive districts for after the big heist payouts. The eighth purchase triggers the unlock.
steps: Watch the map for garage property icons as your money grows.
Buy garages cheapest first to build the collection steadily.
Purchase the eighth and final garage to earn the trophy.
sources: Exophase, Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles, Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: The Scooter Bros app lets you register vehicles to your name, and ten registrations complete this trophy. Register vehicles you actually keep, one per garage slot style, rather than random street cars you will abandon. Each registration is done from the app while you are with the vehicle, so batch them whenever you add a new car or bike to your collection.
steps: Open the Scooter Bros app while standing with a vehicle you own or keep.
Register the vehicle through the app's prompt.
Repeat with ten different vehicles to earn the trophy.
sources: Exophase, Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles, Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
